continent.label: Continent
continent.description: One large landmass with bays and a few offshore islands.

islands.label: Islands
islands.description: Every capital on its own island, with neutral islands in between.

archipelago.label: Archipelago
archipelago.description: Many small islands where sea lanes decide; best with 20 to 30 % land.

elimination.label: Defeat all opponents
elimination.description: The last one still holding cities wins.

capitals.label: Capture the capitals
capitals.description: Whoever holds all enemy capitals wins.

dominance.label: Dominance
dominance.description: Whoever holds the majority of all cities for five own rounds in a row wins: 60 % on the continent, 50 % on islands and archipelagos. Suits island worlds, where hardly anyone is wiped out completely.

roundLimit.label: Round limit
roundLimit.description: After the last round, whoever has the most points for cities and units wins.

kessler.title: Grand Admiral of the Republic
kessler.description: Seeks the decisive battle at sea early on and blockades enemy coasts.

varenne.title: Minister of Trade
varenne.description: Claims neutral islands faster than anyone else and avoids open war as long as she keeps growing.

brandt.title: Chairman of the Hammer House
brandt.description: Turns his cities into fortresses and only advances once enough Steam Colossi stand ready. Attack him too early and you break your teeth on his walls; leave him be for too long and you face a steamroller of steel that takes city after city.

eisenhart.title: Commander-in-Chief of the Colliery Guard
eisenhart.description: Relies on fast Armoured Car thrusts and strikes weakly defended cities at once.

halvorsen.title: Fleet Captain of the Cloud Fleet
halvorsen.description: Knows the map before anyone else and strikes where the defence is thin.

lindqvist.title: Shipwright of Nordhavn
lindqvist.description: Plays a waiting game and reacts to threats.

ostrow.title: Fortress Commandant of Salzwacht
ostrow.description: Holds what he has and defends his coasts to the last man.
